# GNU findutils compatibility — `org.ono.compat.findutils`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `find`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## find — `org.ono.compat.findutils.find`

Found files as `ono.file/1` records, streamed from `find … -printf` with NUL-terminated records.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `find` |
| versions | `>=4.4` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.file/1` |
| decoder | `lines` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `findutils/find` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `find [-H\|-L\|-P] [path …] [tests …] — every test, no action` | `find` | `-H`, `-L`, `-P`, `-xdev`, `-mount`, `-depth`, `-empty`, `-executable`, `-readable`, `-writable`, `-not`, `-a`, `-and`, `-o`, `-or`, `-prune`, `-nogroup`, `-nouser`, `-daystart`, `-follow`, `!`, `(`, `)`, `-maxdepth <value>`, `-mindepth <value>`, `-type <value>`, `-xtype <value>`, `-name <value>`, `-iname <value>`, `-path <value>`, `-ipath <value>`, `-wholename <value>`, `-regex <value>`, `-iregex <value>`, `-regextype <value>`, `-lname <value>`, `-ilname <value>`, `-mtime <value>`, `-atime <value>`, `-ctime <value>`, `-mmin <value>`, `-amin <value>`, `-cmin <value>`, `-newer <value>`, `-anewer <value>`, `-cnewer <value>`, `-newermt <value>`, `-newerat <value>`, `-newerct <value>`, `-size <value>`, `-user <value>`, `-uid <value>`, `-group <value>`, `-gid <value>`, `-perm <value>`, `-links <value>`, `-inum <value>`, `-samefile <value>`, `-fstype <value>`, `-used <value>` | — |

### Limits

- Actions — `-exec`, `-execdir`, `-ok`, `-delete`, `-ls`, `-print`, `-print0`, `-printf`, `-fprint` — make it a different command and run raw.
- `created` and `target` are not reported: find has no birth time, and a link target with a tab in it cannot share a record with the path.
